_comment: Texas Hill Country: meseta continental disecada, sin mar. Mesetas con escarpe, canadas de rio encajadas, encinar disperso en manchas, rancho y cultivo extenso, y nucleos separados unidos por carretera larga. / EN: Texas Hill Country: dissected continental plateau, no sea. Scarped tableland, entrenched river cuts, scattered oak-like patches, ranch and field country, spread towns on long roads.
